# TASK-051-fix — Upgrade libheif 1.17.6 → 1.21.2

## Context

Manual testing of v0.3.2 revealed that ~85 HEIC files fail to decode during library indexing and ~3 during import planning, all with the same error:

```
heif_error: Invalid input: Unspecified: Too many auxiliary image references (2, 0)
```

These are Apple HDR photos (iPhone, iOS 18+) that include gain map auxiliary images alongside depth maps. libheif 1.17.6 rejects files with more than one auxiliary image reference.

**libheif 1.18.0** (changelog: "now reads images generated by iOS 18") fixes this. We upgrade to **1.21.2** (latest stable, 2026-01-16) for maximum compatibility and bug fixes.

## Goal

Upgrade `@keepic/heif-decode` native addon dependencies:
- libheif: 1.17.6 → 1.21.2
- libde265: 1.0.15 → verify if upgrade needed (check compat)

All 85 previously failing HEIC files should decode successfully after the upgrade.

## Key Changes

### 1. `packages/heif-decode/scripts/build-deps.sh`

- Update `LIBHEIF_VERSION="1.21.2"`
- Update `LIBDE265_VERSION` if needed for compatibility
- Verify CMake build flags still work (API may have changed)
- Check if new dependencies are required (1.19+ added optional codecs)
- Ensure we only build with the de265 decoder (no AOM, no x264, no VVC) to keep the binary small

### 2. `packages/heif-decode/src/heif-decode.cc`

- Check if the C++ API (`heif_cxx.h`) has breaking changes between 1.17 and 1.21
- Key functions used: `heif::Context`, `get_primary_image_handle()`, `decode_image()`, `get_plane()`
- Update if any API signatures changed

### 3. `binding.gyp`

- Verify static library names haven't changed
- Check if new static libraries need to be linked (1.19+ has internal restructuring)

### 4. CI workflows

- `build-heif-addon.yml` — verify all 3 platforms still pass
- `release.yml` — verify release builds succeed
- CI uses `libheif-dev` (system, still 1.17.6 on Ubuntu 24.04) for tests — dynamic linking mode unaffected

### 5. Smoke test

- Existing `test/smoke-test.js` with `test/sample.heic` should still pass
- **Add** the problematic Apple HDR HEIC (`IMG_2346.HEIC`) as a second smoke test sample to validate the fix

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|
| libheif 1.21 API breaking changes | Check C++ API diff before upgrading; heif_cxx.h has been stable |
| New required dependencies (AOM, etc.) | Disable all optional codecs in CMake — only de265 needed |
| Larger binary size | Monitor — disable unused features (sequences, tiling, x264, VVC) |
| Windows/MSVC static linking regressions | Same patterns as session 046 — verify `LIBHEIF_STATIC_BUILD` still works |
| CI `libheif-dev` system version mismatch | Tests use dynamic linking (system 1.17.6) — only the C API subset we use matters; shouldn't break |

## Validation

- [ ] `IMG_2346.HEIC` (Apple HDR, previously failing) decodes successfully
- [ ] Existing `test/sample.heic` still decodes
- [ ] Smoke test passes on all 3 CI platforms (linux-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64)
- [ ] Full test suite passes (`npm run test:coverage`)
- [ ] Release build succeeds (Windows + macOS)
